title: EBS volumes are encrypted
remediation: Create an encrypted snapshot copy, restore it to a new encrypted volume and replace the unencrypted volume.
uncertainty: Encrypted=true shows configured encryption only; KMS key policy, grants and key state are not verified.

title: EBS volumes are encrypted
remediation: Create an encrypted snapshot copy, restore it to a new encrypted volume and replace the unencrypted volume.

title: Root account has MFA enabled
remediation: Sign in as root, register a hardware or virtual MFA device under Security credentials, and store recovery material offline. Prefer a hardware or passkey MFA for root.

title: Root account has no active access keys
remediation: Sign in as root and delete the root access keys; use IAM roles or IAM Identity Center for programmatic access.

title: IAM password policy meets the configured baseline
message: Password policy is weaker than baseline: minimum length 8 < 14; reuse prevention 5 < 24
remediation: Set a password policy with the configured minimum length (default 14) and reuse prevention (default 24), or eliminate IAM user passwords via federation.
uncertainty: Only length and reuse prevention are evaluated.

title: GuardDuty detector is enabled in the region
message: GuardDuty is not enabled in this region.
remediation: Enable GuardDuty in every in-use region, ideally centrally managed through AWS Organizations.
uncertainty: Delegated-administrator or suppressed findings are not evaluated.

title: AWS Config recorder is recording and delivering in the region
remediation: Create a configuration recorder and delivery channel, start the recorder, and fix any delivery failures.
uncertainty: Grant the missing read-only permission (see policies/) and re-run; the control result is unknown.

title: Security groups do not allow public ingress to sensitive ports
message: Sensitive ports are open to the internet.
remediation: Restrict sources to known CIDRs, security groups or a VPN; use SSM Session Manager instead of SSH or RDP.
uncertainty: Only exact 0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0 are treated as public; broad CIDRs and attachment to a resource are not evaluated.

title: Security groups do not allow public ingress to sensitive ports
message: No sensitive port is open to the internet.
remediation: Restrict sources to known CIDRs, security groups or a VPN; use SSM Session Manager instead of SSH or RDP.
uncertainty: Only exact 0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0 are treated as public; broad CIDRs and attachment to a resource are not evaluated.

title: S3 bucket Block Public Access is effectively enabled
message: Block Public Access is not fully enabled for this bucket.
remediation: Enable all four Block Public Access settings on the bucket or at account level.

title: S3 bucket Block Public Access is effectively enabled
message: Block Public Access is effectively fully enabled.
remediation: Enable all four Block Public Access settings on the bucket or at account level.
